title: Which ZIA log fields are not logged until enabled

prose.text: Some web log fields are empty unless something is enabled first.

checks.do: Whether an empty client port, server port or allowed DLP rule name is a field that was never enabled rather than missing traffic.
Whether TLS Inspection applies to the traffic before expecting df_hostname.

clt-sport.statement: Logging of the web log client source port, clt_sport, is enabled by contacting Zscaler Support.

quotes: To enable logging for Client Source Port, contact Zscaler Support.

srv-dport.statement: Logging of the web log server destination port, srv_dport, is enabled by contacting Zscaler Support.

quotes: To enable logging for Server Destination Port, contact Zscaler Support.

dlprulename.statement: Logging of the DLP Allowed Rule Name, dlprulename, is enabled by contacting Zscaler Support.

quotes: | %s{dlprulename} | The name of the DLP rule applied to the transaction.
To enable logging for DLP Allowed Rule Name, contact Zscaler Support.

df-tls.statement: df_hostname is populated only when TLS Inspection is enabled.

quotes: TLS Inspection must be enabled for this field to be populated.

firewall-ports.statement: The firewall log lists csport and sdport with no enablement note in its field CSV, while the web log lists the client source port and server destination port as needing Support to enable.
firewall-ports.conditions: Compares two vendor CSVs; the absence of a note in the firewall CSV does not show the ports are on by default.

quotes: this is the client source port of the last session in the aggregate.
this is the server destination port of the last session in the aggregate.
To enable logging for Client Source Port, contact Zscaler Support.
To enable logging for Server Destination Port, contact Zscaler Support.
